Name: Axolotls in Stardew Valley
Author: otohimexoxo
Description:
wild axolotl populations are making a comeback, specifically in Pelican Town! (for some reason)
grab a fishing rod, head to the mountain lake and catch yourself an axolotl today ♡

≽(◕ ᴗ ◕)≼

[b][size=4]3.0.0 update:[/size]
[/b]♡ added baby axolotls! pond axolotls have a chance of producing them and you can sell them and/or put them in fish tanks. (side note: the babies do not count as fish so you don't have to worry about getting them all for your fish collection)
♡ added animations
♡ made axolotls available only in spring/summer rather than all seasons
♡ adjusted axolotls sell price and spawn rate

[b][size=4][img]https://i.imgur.com/m0TFZj4.png[/img] [/size]
[/b]1. download and install content patcher and json assets (and content patcher animations if you want the axolotls animated)
2. download this mod
3. unzip folder into the stardew mods folder
